description: Classifies a verified architecture risk, resolves the current owner and protection gap, and selects the smallest justified hardening response. Project-agnostic; host-specific governance is optional.
do_not_regress: Require a verified current architecture risk before admitting hardening work.
Discover the current owner and existing executable protection before proposing a new checker or subsystem.
Classify findings as HARD_FAILURE, PROTECTION_GAP, TRANSITIONAL_DEBT, WARNING, or NOT_APPLICABLE.
Delegate implementation authorization to the active Project's declared authority and delivery or snapshot/freeze mechanics to current Project or host-specific owners.
Map detector taxonomies to current owners and executable coverage before proposing any new detector surface.
